name: transcribe an algorithm from a photograph of code
definition: Read a code snippet rendered as an image and reconstruct its exact logic when off-the-shelf OCR does not yield clean text.
failure_mode: Any misread character, reordering, or skipped operation yields a different final value and fails equality.

name: transform plain-text files via scripted editor (vim) macros
definition: Compose and execute vim macro keystrokes (from an external script or single file) to rewrite every row/whole file byte-for-byte to an expected layout.
failure_mode: an edge case in some rows leaves residual differences that fail the byte equality

name: verify registered model serialization and parameter shape
definition: ensure the persisted loaded object is a sklearn linear model with coefficient vector length equal to the input feature count.
failure_mode: logging a wrong serialization or feature count yields a load/shape failure

name: write the recovered value with the expected normalization
definition: persist the secret so the stripped contents match the expected string.
failure_mode: trailing whitespace or altered value fails the exact match.
